text: So this is wicked simple to install and saved us from paying a service fee plus the same dang part. Seriously it's like four screws in the back, disconnect two wiring harnesses undo two more screws and then reverse the process.

FIt right in and worked great.  The pins are not in the same positions as the original, but both the original and new are marked (L1, L2, etc.) so make sure you connect the wires to the same labeled pins you take them off of.
Made the old stove get hotter and faster. This can be turned to any position to get the on/off in the proper place.

Easy easy easy.
Take the top panel off on the back, 8mm hex head
Look at each connection
See which one is bad
Pull out knob (use all ten fingers, just pull)
Unscrew the switch, two Philips screw head
Remove one electrical connection and attach to new switch at a time (so you dont forget which connection goes where)
Reverse setup to completion.

Then remove the old switch and install the new one.

This unit works only for the smaller burner on your electric stove. If you need a switch for the larger burner you need the similar looking switch with the higher amperage rating. You will recognize that switch me the red dot on the stem where the control knob goes. This one does not have that colored dot. Other than that it is very easy to replace with just a screw driver(you do need to pull out the stove and unplug it. Access is from the back, which might sound ominous to the non do yourselfer but it really is easy.  Also, there are very good YouTube videos that will guide you through the process.

Easy to install. Had issues with the element not heating properly on lower settings. Now the element heats up on the lower settings like the other elements. Had been told by appliance repairman to turn on on high and lower to the desired set point but that did not work well for the that particular element. Must be sure to match the controller to the proper element size. The original controller will have the range marked on it or you can look it up in the manual for the model number which is usually on the front behind the drawer or oven door.

This worked great with our Frigidaire glass-top stove. It's only been installed for a couple of months now, but so far no issues.

Exactly what I ordered, install is easy but you have to shot off breaker, pull out oven, remove top back access cover, take pic of where all wires go to on terminals, pull off wires, pull off control knob on front, unscrew two screws on front, pull out old switch and position new switch, screw in on front, connect all wires, turn breaker back on, test it, if element works, turn off element, turn off breaker, close back panel, push oven back.

I bought this OEM Range Switch 316436001 to replace the old range switch that was malfunctioning.  This switch was identical to the old one.  The installation instructions made it simple to replace.  After replacing the switch my Kenmore range worked like new.  Completely satisfied with this product.

All repair jobs should be this easy! Took about 5 minutes and works like new.

BEFORE you remove wires from old switch, just Be Sure to mark wires (with small piece of masking tape) annotating which male contacts on old switch they came off (Especially when 2 wires of same / or almost same color).  Contact ID's are embossed on both old and new switch.  Then all you do is put them on same contact on new switch.

This switch was the exact replacement we needed for our Frigidaire glass top. Stinkbugs sold separately?
